audit.why: Levels 1-2 even on Granite Shield plus Seismic Shard poke, Levels 2-3 through First item hers once the tentacle field exists, late swinging back to Malphite as a frontline. That matches 49.49% over 784 games — a genuinely even matchup whose lane phase is lopsided toward her.
audit.corrected: Kept the stage ownership; added the cooldown that actually creates the windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes are described by level only. The Level 6 spike correctly warns that your knock-up groups you for her tentacles, but neither ult carries a cooldown, so 'her single best kill setup' has no clock.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s and Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s — at rank 1 hers is back before yours, which is exactly why trading ults on the field loses. Her real lane spike is Test of Spirit at 16/15/14/13/12s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and the Level 2-3 spike now carry the numbers that make the advice decidable.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'late' text claims a flank Unstoppable Force 'interrupts her R'. Nothing in the data supports that Leap of Faith is interruptible, and the kit file's needsResearch block is empty, which means unknown rather than yes.
audit.why: Riot's description of Leap of Faith does not mark it a channel, and the kit's derived flags for it ('grounding', 'untargetable') contradict that same description, which mentions neither — so the flags are unreliable here too. Separately, the file DOES support the interaction the page misses: Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever her tentacles damage a champion, and Harsh Lesson is a 4s auto-reset dash that makes nearby tentacles swing at the same target. The 4s dash, not the 16s E, is the tell that a burst is landing.
audit.corrected: Unverified R-interrupt claim removed rather than replaced with its opposite; Harsh Lesson's 4s auto-reset added as the burst tell and Prophet of an Elder God named as the healing source.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' — confirmed. The full layer repeats 'track Test of Spirit' nine times without ever saying how long it is down for.
audit.why: Test of Spirit at 16/15/14/13/12s is one of the longest lane cooldowns in the game. A missed E is a 16-second window in which her only step-up is a 4s Harsh Lesson — that is when Malphite farms freely or crashes a wave.
audit.corrected: The 16s window is now stated as the thing you play around.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart (by his AD profile)' with a parenthetical that reads like unfilled template text, and prescribes anti-heal without naming what heals her.
audit.why: Armour and Plated Steelcaps ARE correct here — her damage is physical — so unlike most of Malphite's AP lanes this line only needs the healing source named. Prophet of an Elder God is the heal, and it triggers off tentacles hitting champions, so Grievous Wounds matters in the extended field fight, not the poke.
audit.corrected: Kept the armour core, named Prophet of an Elder God as the reason anti-heal is bought.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Ground Slam's' in the late text as a suspect name — it is a false positive. Ground Slam is the correct name of Malphite's E and the attack-speed reduction described is right.
audit.corrected: No change needed to that phrase.

edits.after: Illaoi's takeover: with two tentacles up, Test of Spirit (16s at rank 1) rips your spirit and every slam stacks on you — never fight inside her field, just farm.

edits.after: Once she has two tentacles and Test of Spirit, fighting on the field rips your spirit — but that E is 16s, so a miss hands you a long free window to farm or crash.

edits.before: This is her lane, plainly. Levels 4-5 my W/E and armor finally come online, but Illaoi doesn't care — she fights inside a forest of tentacles where my short-range kit and Granite Shield mean nothing, and her slams out-sustain anything I can do. I do not all-in her on the field, ever. At 6 it gets worse before it gets better: her R Leap of Faith spawns a whole ring of tentacles, and my Unstoppable Force R is a knock-up that just clumps me up to be slammed. Only ever R her to knock her AWAY from her tentacles or to leave lane — never into the field.
edits.after: This is her lane, plainly. Levels 4-5 my W/E and armor finally come online, but Illaoi doesn't care — she fights inside a forest of tentacles where my short-range kit and Granite Shield mean nothing, and her slams out-sustain anything I can do. Her tell is Harsh Lesson: a 4s auto-reset dash that makes every nearby tentacle swing at me, so the dash is the cue to walk, not the slam. I do not all-in her on the field, ever. At 6 it gets worse before better: Leap of Faith rings her in tentacles and my R only clumps me to be slammed. Only R her AWAY from the field.

edits.before: My path back to even is the same thing that makes her a monster: she is glued to her tentacle field and completely immobile off it. Late game I stop trying to duel her in the sidelane — that's a loss — and play the frontline I'm built to be. Two items of armor plus Ground Slam's attack-speed slow lets me eat her slams in a 5v5, and a flank Unstoppable Force that drags her off her tentacles or interrupts her R turns her from unkillable to helpless. Win the teamfight, not the lane.
edits.after: My path back to even is the same thing that makes her a monster: she is glued to her tentacle field and completely immobile off it. edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit (16/15/14/13/12s): matchup-defining — sidestep it and you own the next 16 seconds. - Harsh Lesson is only 4s: the dash, not the slam, is the burst tell. - Leap of Faith 120s beats your R back.

edits.before: Track Illaoi's Test of Spirit: Her vessel pull. Sidestep it. When it is down — R-W-E her.
edits.after: Sidestep Test of Spirit and you own 16s. Harsh Lesson's 4s dash is the real burst tell.

edits.before: Illaoi wastes Test of Spirit — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: She misses Test of Spirit — you have 16 free seconds. Use them.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her spirit echoes your damage back — break the tether or kill it fast.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is a teamfight win button — the lane is just where you bank it. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart  (by his AD profile), then Thornmail / Abyssal Mask; boots Plated Steelcaps. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.

notes: Removed the claim that a flank Unstoppable Force 'interrupts her R'. Riot's Leap of Faith description does not mark it a channel and the kit's needsResearch block is empty, so this is unknown, not false — I deleted the assertion rather than asserting the opposite, and it is listed in unverified. The kit file's derived flags on Leap of Faith ('grounding', 'untargetable') contradict Riot's own description of that ability, which mentions neither, so I treated them as tooltip-parsing misfires. Note this is a rare Malphite lane where the templated 'build armor / Plated Steelcaps' line is actually correct — Illaoi is physical damage — so I kept the armour core instead of swapping it to MR as in his AP matchups.
